name: Jennifer Lynn-Fragale
career_history: Senior Estimator at GH Phipps Construction Companies, 11/2025 to present; Senior Estimator at Howell Construction, 4/2017 to 11/2025; Project Manager / Estimator at Adams Mendel Allison Construction, 8/2014 to 1/2016; Project Engineer at Gerald H Phipps, 2/2012 to 8/2014; Project Engineer / Senior Project Administrator at Saunders Construction, 8/1999 to 2/2012; Project Coordinator at Mendle-Allison Construction, 5/1997 to 8/1999
education: Associates of Liberal Arts & Applied Science, Arapahoe Community College
Bachelor of Science, Construction Management, Westwood College - Aurora
biography:
Dynamic, resourceful and efficient LEED Accredited Professional with 30+ years of experience in successful project administration, management, and preconstruction services. Proven track record of assessing organizational needs, completing projects independently and with good business acumen, often times completing multiple projects under pressure and ahead of schedule. Leader that utilizes excellent problem-solving and verbal/written communication skills in training and mentoring new employees and peers. Efficient and effective multi-tasker successful in complex administrative and executive administrative duties. Expert with Microsoft Office Suite, CMiC Construction Management Software, Bluebeam, PlanSwift, BuildingConnected, and various other software packages.

Specialties: Specializing in diverse market sectors including Office, Data Centers, Sports and Recreation, High Rise, Education, Municipal, Healthcare, Hospitality, Industrial and Religious facilities ranging from $100,000 to $70,000,000.
